title: The Wettest Jump
lines: It was the hottest day of all.
Meg and Tim went to the pool.
Then Dad ran in with a big jump.
Meg and Tim got the wettest of all.

questions.ask: What were Meg and Tim arguing about?
questions.listenFor: Whose splash was bigger. Have them read the two quotes.

questions.ask: Who made the biggest splash in the end?
questions.listenFor: Dad. The last line does not name him, so they must hold on to the line before.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg and Tim minded getting wet? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer. The hot day is a good reason to point at.
